sample_unit: daily summaries of remote monitoring time series

links.outcome: Event-level fidelity of LLM summaries: abnormality recall, duration recall, hallucinated event mentions
links.effect: Models with high semantic similarity often show near-zero abnormality recall; the vision-based approach reached 45.7% abnormality recall and 100% duration recall.
links.quote: Models that achieve high semantic similarity scores often exhibit near-zero abnormality recall.

unlisted_practices: Event-based evaluation framework aligning LLM summaries of time series to rule-derived clinical events
Vision-based prompting using rendered time-series visualizations to improve summary event fidelity

screen.reason: The study develops an evaluation benchmark/metric to test the clinical event fidelity and hallucination rate of LLMs/multimodal models summarizing remote monitoring time-series data.
